description: Damaged, under the cap: the payer of KIK-1013 sends a photo of a snapped handle on the $48.00 market basket. Expected allow: refund-damaged with a photo, and $48.00 is under its $50.00 cap. The photo is an illustrative drawing. The message is simulated. Illustrative people and orders.

messages.subject: Market basket KIK-1013 handle snapped
messages.body:
